Legend.title: How to read this
Legend.intro: Colours follow the <link>European Air Quality Index</link> (EAQI) of the European Environment Agency. Advice is theirs, not ours.
Legend.noDataHint: No reading for this hour yet.
Legend.pm25: Particles under 2.5 µm: smoke, traffic, heating. Small enough to reach the bloodstream. The number that matters most.
Legend.pm10: Particles under 10 µm: dust, pollen, road wear. Irritate airways.
Legend.eaqi: 0 to 100+. Driven by the worst pollutant of the hour, so it can be higher than PM alone suggests.
Legend.rh: Relative humidity. Cheap optical sensors count water droplets as dust: above 70 % their PM readings run high.
Legend.modelVsSensors: The model is a Europe-wide forecast on a ~10 km grid, smooth and blind to your street. Sensors are real but hyper-local and noisy. They disagree often. Both are shown on purpose.
Legend.disclaimer: Not medical advice. Data: Open-Meteo (CAMS) and sensor.community, refreshed hourly.
